== Description ==
'''UI-83''' is the 5th entity you may encounter within [[Section Interchange]], more info below.

== Behavior ==
When '''UI-83''' spawns, it will play the composition known as "Horror Race", like all the other entities that reside within the I-Section. If there are more entities present, it will play the same song but with a higher pitch and speed.

'''UI-83''' will appear from the front, staying infront the door for a short while before rushing back, it will Despawn past voidwall, overall works very similar to [[A-85]].

== Strategy & Tips ==
Hide as soon as you see him, since Claustrophobia takes an extremely long time to attack when in [[Section Interchange]].

== Trivia ==
* Like most UI entities, '''UI-83''' was added as a joke.
